text:
alex: Quick sync — planning note: propose we add predictive smoothing for reserved pools before GA. Idea: use short-term ML signal to prewarm or softly expand headroom to avoid thrash and reduce spill_to_shared instances.

mei: Love the idea. How would we surface it in Console? Customers want to see "predicted spike" + confidence.

jorge: Ops concern: predictions wrong could waste capacity. Need safety rules: only allow predictive add when model confidence > 0.75 AND shared_pool_spill_rate > 0.2% recently. Also cap added headroom to 20% of pool.

tara: Sales: customers would pay for "predictive smoothing" if it reduces visible tail-latency. Could package as "Priority Smoothing" add-on. Need clear metrics pre/post.

alex: Proposed minimal pilot scope:
- predictive smoothing toggle behind feature flag
- Console shows predicted delta + confidence badge
- safety rules: confidence + recent spill signal + cap to 20%
- telemetry: reserve.predict_{start,scale,abort}, reserve.predicted_confidence
- fallback: if prediction causes increased spill_to_shared, auto-revert after 10m

mei: UX mock: show a small chip in pool view: "Smoothing: +12% (0.82)" and a link to "why". Also show a timeseries overlay of predicted headroom vs actual.

jorge: Runtime sketch: add a predictive controller that emits an intent event. Controller writes to a decision queue; infra picks up and attempts scale if safety checks pass. Pseudocode:```python
if model.confidence > 0.75 and recent_spill_rate > 0.002:
    delta = min(model.delta, pool.size * 0.2)
    enqueue_scale(pool, delta, reason="predictive_smooth")
```

tara: Legal note: if we proactively expand capacity, do we need to bill for provisioned GPUs or only for consumed tokens? Pricing needs clarity. Finance prefers billing only for actual usage but customers might want guaranteed headroom billing.

alex: For pilot, bill only for actual usage. If customer wants reserved billed headroom, make a separate contract. We should log predicted adds for invoicing traceability.

mei: Also suggest we combine predictive smoothing with regional spill routing: when pool in region A predicts spike, proactively route low-priority spill to region B if latency impact is acceptable. Configurable per-tenant.

jorge: Routing matrix idea: prefer local pools, fallback region list per-tenant, max added latency 120ms. We need per-tenant opt-in for cross-region spill. Default off for enterprise with isolation.

alex: Decision proposals for roadmap (we can finalize Tues):
1) Pilot predictive smoothing behind flag; default off.
2) Safety checks: confidence > 0.75, recent_spill_rate > 0.2%, cap 20% pool size.
3) Console: predicted delta + confidence + timeseries overlay.
4) Billing: pilot = usage-based only; contract-billed headroom as paid option.
5) Regional spill routing = opt-in per-tenant; max latency 120ms; default off for enterprise.

tara: GTM plan: frame as "latency smoothing" add-on. Prep A/B test with 2 pilot customers, measure tail-p99 and spill events. Marketing to run a one-pager for pilot.

mei: Telemetry owner volunteers: I'll own event schema and console badges. Event names: reserve.predict_start, reserve.predict_scale, reserve.predict_revert, reserve.predict_confidence.

jorge: Infra owner: I'll implement decision queue + safety checks. Will add an alert: predictive_revert_rate > 1% -> auto-disable feature flag for pool.

pilot-bot: feature-flag created: reserve.predictive_smoothing.canary (internal only).

alex: Timeline: prototype 4w, infra safety hooks 3w, Console mock + telemetry 3w. Owners: alex (product), mei (telemetry + console), jorge (infra + decision queue), tara (GTM + contracts).

alex: Thanks all. If no major objections, lock for Tuesday planning sync and add to dedicated roadmap doc. :thumbsup:
